en.s: The Battle of Karuse or Battle on the Ice was fought on 16 February 1270 between the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and the Livonian Order on the frozen Baltic Sea between the island of Muhu and the mainland. The Lithuanians achieved a decisive victory. The battle, named after the village of Karuse, was the fifth-largest defeat of the Livonian or Teutonic Orders in the 13th century.

zh.s: 卡鲁塞之战又称冰上之战，于1270年2月16日爆发。立陶宛大公国与利沃尼亚骑士团在波罗的海结冰海面上交战，地点位于穆胡岛与大陆之间。立陶宛人取得决定性胜利。这场战役以附近的卡鲁塞村命名，是13世纪利沃尼亚骑士团或条顿骑士团遭遇的第五大败仗。

en.s: The siege of Diu occurred when a combined Ottoman-Gujarati force defeated a Portuguese attempt to capture the city of Diu in 1531. The victory was partly the result of Ottoman firepower over the Portuguese besiegers deployed by Mustafa Bayram, an Ottoman expert. Shortly before the siege the Portuguese encountered roughly 800 enemy soldiers at Siyâl Bet island[a], engaged them in combat, and killed them all.

zh.s: 1531年，奥斯曼与古吉拉特联军挫败葡萄牙人夺取第乌城的企图，第乌围城战由此发生。奥斯曼专家穆斯塔法·巴伊拉姆部署的火力，是联军获胜的原因之一。围城前不久，葡萄牙人在西亚尔贝特岛[a]遇到约800名敌军，与其交战并将其全部杀死。

en.s: The Battle of the Malandari Pass was fought on 16 February 1586 in what is now the Buner District in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province. The army of the Mughal Empire, led by Raja Birbal, was ambushed by Pashtun Yusufzai tribesmen, led by Malik Kalu Khan Yousafzai. It was one of the greatest defeats of Mughal history and under the reign of Akbar the Great.

zh.s: 1586年2月16日，拉贾·比尔巴尔率领的莫卧儿帝国军队，在今天巴基斯坦开伯尔—普什图省布内尔区的马兰达里隘口，遭马利克·卡卢汗·优素福扎伊率领的普什图优素福扎伊部落战士伏击。这是莫卧儿历史及阿克巴大帝统治期间最惨重的失败之一。

en.s: On 16 February 1595, a Gaelic Irish force assaulted and captured the English-held Blackwater Fort at Blackwatertown in County Armagh. The Irish were led by Art MacBaron O'Neill, brother of Hugh O'Neill, Earl of Tyrone, and marked Tyrone's break with the English Crown as he openly waged war against the English forces in Ireland.

zh.s: 1595年2月16日，一支盖尔爱尔兰军队袭击并攻占阿马郡黑水镇由英格兰控制的黑水堡。爱尔兰军队由蒂龙伯爵休·奥尼尔的兄弟阿特·麦克巴伦·奥尼尔率领。这标志着蒂龙与英格兰王室决裂，开始公开向驻爱尔兰英军作战。

en.s: The Battle of Torrington (16 February 1646) was a decisive battle of the south-western campaign of the First English Civil War and marked the end of Royalist resistance in the West Country. It took place in Torrington, Devon.

zh.s: 1646年2月16日，第一次英国内战西南战役期间，双方在德文郡托灵顿展开决定性战斗，标志着保王派在英格兰西部的抵抗结束。

en.t: Earl of Wilmington succeeds Walpole as prime minister
en.s: On 16 February 1742 in the British calendar then in use, Spencer Compton, Earl of Wilmington, became prime minister of Great Britain after Robert Walpole.
en.n: This preserves the source’s OldStyle month and day; the year is stated with a January1 year start.

zh.t: 威尔明顿伯爵接任英国首相
zh.s: 按英国当时使用的历法，1742年2月16日，威尔明顿伯爵斯宾塞·康普顿接替罗伯特·沃波尔，出任大不列颠首相。
zh.n: 月日沿用原文所列旧历日期，年份按1月为年初记作1742年。

en.s: The invasion of Ceylon was a military campaign fought as a series of amphibious operations between the summer of 1795 and spring of 1796 between the garrison of the Batavian colonies on the Indian Ocean island of Ceylon (now Sri Lanka) and a British invasion force sent from British India.
en.n: Colombo in Ceylon (now Sri Lanka) falls to the British, completing their invasion of Ceylon.

zh.s: 锡兰入侵是1795年夏季至1796年春季的一场军事行动，由一系列两栖作战组成。交战双方是驻扎在印度洋锡兰岛（今斯里兰卡）的巴达维亚殖民地守军，以及从英属印度出发的英国入侵部队。
zh.n: 英军攻占锡兰的科伦坡，完成对锡兰的入侵。

en.s: The Battle of Ostrołęka was fought on 16 February 1807 between First French Empire troops under General of Division Anne Jean Marie René Savary and Russian soldiers under Lieutenant General Ivan Essen. The French defeated the Russians and forced them to retreat to the east to Wyoki Mazowiecki. Weather conditions caused both sides to go into winter quarters immediately after the battle, which occurred during the War of the Fourth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars. Ostrołęka is located in the northeast part of modern Poland, but in 1807 it belonged to the Kingdom of Prussia.

zh.s: 1807年2月16日，法兰西第一帝国安娜·让·马里·勒内·萨瓦里师级将军率军，与伊万·埃森中将指挥的俄军在奥斯特罗文卡交战。法军获胜，迫使俄军向东退至维索凯马佐维茨凯。受天气影响，双方在战后立即进入冬季营地。这场战役属于拿破仑战争中的第四次反法同盟战争。奥斯特罗文卡位于今天波兰东北部，但在1807年属于普鲁士王国。

en.t: 1833 Costa Rican Head of State election
en.s: Head of State elections were held in Costa Rica between 3 and 16 February 1833. Former congressman Manuel Aguilar Chacón, supported primarily by liberal groups in San José and Alajuela, received 21 electoral votes from the second-degree electors chosen in the preceding popular election. Under the Fundamental Law of the State of Costa Rica, a candidate was required to obtain an absolute majority of the electoral vote.

zh.t: 1833年哥斯达黎加国家元首选举
zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于1833年2月3日至16日举行国家元首选举。前国会议员曼努埃尔·阿吉拉尔·查孔主要得到圣何塞及阿拉胡埃拉自由派支持，获得21张选举人票。这些第二级选举人由此前的民众选举产生。根据《哥斯达黎加州基本法》，候选人须取得过半选举人票才能当选。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 16 February 1846. Eugenio Aguilar ran unopposed and was elected by the legislature. His term began on 21 February 1846.

zh.s: 萨尔瓦多于1846年2月16日举行总统选举。欧亨尼奥·阿吉拉尔在没有对手的情况下由议会选为总统，于2月21日开始任期。

en.t: American Civil War: A Union victory at the Battle of Fort Donelson gave General Ulysses S. Grant the nickname "Unconditional Surrender"
en.s: The Battle of Fort Donelson was fought from February 11–16, 1862, in the Western Theater of the American Civil War. The Union capture of the Confederate fort near the Tennessee–Kentucky border opened the Cumberland River, an important avenue for the invasion of the South. The Union's success also elevated Brig. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant from an obscure and largely unproven leader to the rank of major general, and earned him the nickname of "Unconditional Surrender" Grant.

zh.t: 美国南北战争：唐纳尔森堡战役北军获胜，尤利西斯·S·格兰特因此得到“不接受投降条件”的绰号
zh.s: 唐纳尔森堡战役于1862年2月11日至16日在美国南北战争西部战区进行。北军攻占这座靠近田纳西州与肯塔基州边界的南军堡垒，控制了坎伯兰河这条入侵南方的重要通道。北军获胜后，原本名不见经传、战绩未获充分证明的准将尤利西斯·S·格兰特晋升少将，并得到“不接受投降条件”（Unconditional Surrender）的绰号。

en.s: The Saga Rebellion (佐賀の乱, Saga no ran) was an 1874 uprising in Kyūshū against the new Meiji government of Japan. It was led by Etō Shinpei and Shima Yoshitake in their native domain of Hizen.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 佐贺之乱（日文：佐賀の乱）是1874年发生在日本九州、反抗明治新政府的一场起义。起义由江藤新平和岛义勇领导，发生在他们的故乡肥前。

en.s: The 1889 New South Wales colonial election was held between 1 February and 16 February 1889. This election was for all of the 137 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 37 single-member constituencies, nineteen 2-member constituencies, ten 3-member constituencies and eight 4-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system.

zh.s: 1889年新南威尔士殖民地选举于当年2月1日至16日举行，改选新南威尔士立法议会全部137个席位。全境划分为37个单议席选区、19个双议席选区、10个三议席选区和8个四议席选区，均采用简单多数制。

en.s: On 16 February 1899, the club now known as Knattspyrnufélag Reykjavíkur, or KR, was founded in Reykjavík, Iceland. It is Iceland’s oldest football club.

zh.t: 冰岛雷克雅未克KR足球俱乐部成立
zh.s: 1899年2月16日，今天称为雷克雅未克KR的足球俱乐部在冰岛雷克雅未克成立，是冰岛历史最悠久的足球俱乐部。

en.s: The Southern Cross Expedition, otherwise known as the British Antarctic Expedition, 1898–1900, was the first British venture of the Heroic Age of Antarctic Exploration, and the forerunner of the more celebrated journeys of Robert Falcon Scott and Ernest Shackleton.
en.n: The Southern Cross expedition led by Carsten Borchgrevink achieves a new Farthest South of 78° 50'S, making the first landing at the Great Ice Barrier.

zh.s: 南十字星远征又称1898至1900年英国南极远征，是英雄时代南极探索时期英国开展的首项探险活动，也为后来罗伯特·法尔肯·斯科特和欧内斯特·沙克尔顿更广为人知的探险行程开了先河。
zh.n: 卡斯滕·博克格雷温克率领的南十字星远征抵达南纬78°50′，创下“最远南进”纪录，并首次登陆大冰障。

en.s: General elections were held in Costa Rica on 16 February 1902. The elections took place in a context of heightened political tension. President Rafael Yglesias's administration, which had been marked by authoritarian tendencies, faced increasing opposition after his controversial re-election in 1897. That earlier victory had been secured through a constitutional reform widely considered undemocratic, as Yglesias ran unopposed and maintained full control of Congress.

zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于1902年2月16日举行大选，当时政治局势日益紧张。总统拉斐尔·伊格莱西亚斯政府带有威权倾向，他在1897年争议性连任后，面临越来越强的反对。那次连任依靠一项被普遍认为不民主的修宪实现：伊格莱西亚斯在没有对手的情况下参选，并完全控制国会。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 16 February 1903. General Pedro José Escalón was elected with 78 percent of the vote. President Tomás Regalado hand-picked Escalón to be his successor. All men were eligible to vote in the election.

zh.s: 萨尔瓦多于1903年2月16日举行总统选举。总统托马斯·雷加拉多亲自选定的继任者佩德罗·何塞·埃斯卡隆将军，以78%的得票率当选。所有男性均有资格投票。

en.s: The 1909 Pittsburgh mayoral election was held on Tuesday, February 16, 1909. Republican nominee William A. Magee was elected mayor of Pittsburgh over Civic Party and Prohibition candidate W.H. Stevenson and Democratic candidate George R. Herst.

zh.s: 1909年2月16日（星期二），匹兹堡举行市长选举。共和党提名人威廉·A·马吉击败公民党和禁酒党候选人W·H·史蒂文森，以及民主党候选人乔治·R·赫斯特，当选市长。

en.s: The 1911 Cambridge University by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 11-16 February 1911. The constituency returned two Members of Parliament to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system.

zh.s: 1911年2月11日至16日，英国国会举行剑桥大学选区补选。该选区向下议院选出两名议员，采用简单多数制。

en.t: Edmonton holds its post-amalgamation municipal election
en.s: On February 16, 1912, Edmonton, Canada, held municipal elections following its amalgamation with Strathcona on February1.

zh.t: 埃德蒙顿在合并后举行市政选举
zh.s: 1912年2月16日，加拿大埃德蒙顿举行市政选举。此前2月1日，埃德蒙顿已与斯特拉斯科纳合并。

en.s: The Erzurum offensive (Russian: Эрзурумское сражение, romanized: Erzurumskoe srazhenie; Turkish: Erzurum Taarruzu) or Battle of Erzurum (Turkish: Erzurum Muharebesi) was a major winter offensive by the Imperial Russian Army on the Caucasus Campaign, during the First World War that led to the capture of the strategic city of Erzurum. The Turkish forces, in winter quarters, suffered a series of unexpected reverses, which led to a Russian victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 埃尔祖鲁姆攻势又称埃尔祖鲁姆战役，是第一次世界大战高加索战役期间，俄罗斯帝国陆军发动的一次重大冬季攻势，最终夺取战略要城埃尔祖鲁姆。驻冬营的土耳其军队接连遭遇意外失利，俄军取得胜利。

en.s: The Act of Independence of Lithuania (Lithuanian: Lietuvos Nepriklausomybės Aktas) or the Act of February 16th, also the Lithuanian Resolution on Independence (Lithuanian: Lietuvos Nepriklausomybės Nutarimas), was signed by the Council of Lithuania on February 16, 1918. It proclaimed independence from Russia and the restoration of an independent State of Lithuania, governed by democratic principles, with Vilnius as its capital.

zh.s: 立陶宛独立法案（立陶宛语：Lietuvos Nepriklausomybės Aktas）又称2月16日法案或立陶宛独立决议（立陶宛语：Lietuvos Nepriklausomybės Nutarimas），由立陶宛委员会于1918年2月16日签署。法案宣布立陶宛脱离俄罗斯独立，并恢复独立的立陶宛国家；新国家将实行民主制度，首都设在维尔纽斯。

en.t: Bolsheviks briefly take control of Sukhumi
en.s: On 16 February 1918, Russian warships carrying Bolshevik-aligned soldiers entered Sukhumi in Abkhazia. Bolsheviks took control after clashes and formed a military revolutionary committee, but local authorities were restored on February21. The city lies in the disputed Abkhazia region, internationally recognized as part of Georgia.

zh.t: 布尔什维克短暂控制苏呼米
zh.s: 1918年2月16日，载有支持布尔什维克士兵的俄罗斯军舰进入阿布哈兹苏呼米。冲突后，布尔什维克控制该城并成立军事革命委员会，但当地原有当局于2月21日恢复。苏呼米位于有争议的阿布哈兹地区，国际上承认该地区属于格鲁吉亚。

en.s: Constituent Assembly elections were held in Austria on 16 February 1919. The Social Democratic Workers' Party emerged as the largest party, winning 72 of the 170 seats. The party was largely supported by the working class, whilst farmers and the middle class voted mainly for the anti-Anschluss Christian Social Party. Voter turnout was 84.4%.

zh.s: 奥地利于1919年2月16日举行制宪议会选举。社会民主工党成为第一大党，赢得170席中的72席，主要得到工人阶级支持。农民和中产阶级则大多投票给反对德奥合并的基督教社会党。投票率为84.4%。

en.s: Constituent Assembly elections were held in the Democratic Republic of Georgia between 14 and 16 February 1919. The electoral system used was party-list proportional representation using the D'Hondt method in a single nationwide district. The result was a victory for the Social Democratic Party of Georgia, which won 81% of the vote, and 109 of the 130 seats.

zh.s: 格鲁吉亚民主共和国于1919年2月14日至16日举行制宪议会选举。选举采用全国单一选区的政党名单比例代表制，并使用汉狄法计算席位。格鲁吉亚社会民主党获胜，赢得81%的选票和130个席位中的109席。

en.t: Wexford wins the postponed1918 All-Ireland football final
en.s: On 16 February 1919, Wexford defeated Tipperary by five points to four in the1918 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final at Croke Park, Dublin, in present-day Ireland. The match had been postponed because of the influenza pandemic.

zh.t: 韦克斯福德赢得延期举行的1918年全爱尔兰盖尔足球决赛
zh.s: 1919年2月16日，韦克斯福德在今爱尔兰都柏林克罗克公园，以5分比4分击败蒂珀雷里，赢得1918年全爱尔兰高级盖尔足球锦标赛决赛。这场比赛因流感大流行而延期举行。

en.t: Romanian football body reorganized as an independent federation
en.s: On February 16, 1930, Romania’s central football commission became the Romanian Football Association Federation, an independent body with legal authority.

zh.t: 罗马尼亚足球管理机构改组为独立足协
zh.s: 1930年2月16日，罗马尼亚中央足球委员会改组为罗马尼亚足球协会联合会，成为具有法律权限的独立机构。

en.s: The Irish general election of 1932 was held on 16 February 1932, just over two weeks after the dissolution of the Dáil on 29 January. The newly elected 153 members of the 7th Dáil assembled at Leinster House on 9 March 1932 when the new President of the Executive Council and Executive Council of the Irish Free State were appointed by Governor-General James McNeill on the nomination of Dáil Éireann. The general election took place in 30 parliamentary constituencies throughout the Irish Free State for 153 seats in the lower house of parliament, Dáil Éireann.

zh.s: 1932年1月29日众议院解散后两周多，爱尔兰于2月16日举行大选，在自由邦全国30个选区选出众议院153席。第七届众议院新当选的153名议员于3月9日在伦斯特府开会，总督詹姆斯·麦克尼尔根据众议院提名，任命爱尔兰自由邦新一届行政委员会主席及行政委员会。

en.t: Japanese army convenes Manchurian leaders to plan an administrative committee
en.s: On 16 February 1932, the Japanese army convened Zang Shiyi, Zhang Jinghui, Xi Qia and Ma Zhanshan to plan a Northeast Administrative Committee in Manchuria, China. This preceded the formal establishment of the Japanese puppet state of Manchukuo on March1.
en.n: This is the February16 preparatory conference, not formal establishment of Manchukuo on March1 or the February18 declaration.

zh.t: 日军召集会议，筹建东北行政委员会
zh.s: 1932年2月16日，日军在中国东北召集臧式毅、张景惠、熙洽和马占山开会，筹建东北行政委员会。这是在3月1日伪满洲国正式成立之前的筹备活动。
zh.n: 此条记录2月16日的筹备会议，区别于2月18日的声明及3月1日伪满洲国正式成立。

en.t: Newfoundland’s Commission of Government sworn in
en.s: On 16 February 1934, Newfoundland’s Commission of Government was sworn in, replacing responsible government with an appointed administration. Newfoundland is now part of Canada but did not join the Canadian confederation until1949.

zh.t: 纽芬兰政府委员会宣誓就职
zh.s: 1934年2月16日，纽芬兰政府委员会宣誓就职，由任命的政府接替责任政府。纽芬兰如今属于加拿大，但当时尚未加入加拿大联邦，直到1949年才加入。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Spain on 16 February 1936. At stake were all 473 seats in the unicameral Cortes Generales. The winners of the 1936 elections were the Popular Front, a left-wing coalition of the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE), Republican Left (Spain) (IR), Esquerra Republicana de Catalunya (ERC), Republican Union Party (UR), Communist Party (PCE), Acció Catalana (AC) and other parties. They commanded a narrow lead in terms of the popular vote, but a significant lead over the main opposition party, Spanish Confederation of the Autonomous Right (CEDA), of the political right in terms of seats.

zh.s: 西班牙于1936年2月16日举行议会选举，改选一院制议会全部473席。人民阵线获胜，这是由西班牙工人社会党、共和左翼、加泰罗尼亚共和左翼、共和联盟党、共产党、加泰罗尼亚行动党及其他政党组成的左翼联盟。人民阵线总得票仅略微领先，但席位数明显超过主要右翼反对党西班牙右翼自治组织联合会。

en.t: Carothers granted US patent for linear condensation polymers

en.s: The Altmark incident (Norwegian: Altmark-affæren; German: Altmark-Zwischenfall) was a naval incident of World War II between British destroyers and the German tanker Altmark, which happened on 16–17 February 1940. It took place in what were neutral Norwegian waters. On board the Altmark were roughly 300 Allied prisoners (officially internees), whose ships had been sunk by the pocket battleship Graf Spee in the Southern Atlantic Ocean.

zh.s: 1940年2月16日至17日，二战期间，英国驱逐舰与德国油轮“阿尔特马克”号在当时中立的挪威水域发生海上冲突。油轮载有约300名盟军俘虏，正式身份称被拘留人员，他们原来所在船只曾在南大西洋被袖珍战列舰“施佩伯爵”号击沉。

en.s: The Attack on Aruba was an attack on oil installations and tankers by Axis submarines during World War II. On 16 February 1942, a German U-boat attacked the small island of Aruba. Other submarines patrolled the area for shipping and they sank or damaged tankers. Aruba was home to two of the largest oil refineries in the world during the war against the Axis powers, the Arend Petroleum Maatschappij, situated near the Oranjestad harbor and the Lago Oil and Transport Company at the San Nicolas harbor. The attack resulted in the disruption of vital Allied fuel production.

zh.s: 二战期间的1942年2月16日，一艘德国潜艇袭击阿鲁巴岛的石油设施，其他轴心国潜艇也在周边巡弋，击沉或击伤油轮。当时阿鲁巴有两座世界规模最大的炼油厂，分别为奥拉涅斯塔德港附近的阿伦德石油公司，以及圣尼古拉斯港的拉戈石油运输公司。袭击使盟军至关重要的燃料生产受到干扰。

en.t: Greek National Liberation Front establishes ELAS
en.s: On February 16, 1942, Greece’s National Liberation Front established the Greek People’s Liberation Army, ELAS, as an armed resistance organization. Its first actions against German and Italian occupation forces followed later in 1942.

en.s: The Portsmouth North by-election of 1943 was held on 16 February 1943. The by-election was held due to the elevation to the peerage of the incumbent Conservative MP, Sir Roger Keyes. It was won by the Conservative candidate William Milbourne James.

en.s: The Battle of Korsun–Cherkassy (Russian: Корсунь-Шевченковская операция; Ukrainian: Корсунь-Шевченківська операція), also known as the Battle of the Korsun–Cherkassy Pocket, was a World War II battle fought from 24 January to 16 February 1944 in the course of the Soviet Dnieper–Carpathian offensive in Ukraine, following the Korsun–Shevchenkovsky offensive. In the battle, the 1st and 2nd Ukrainian Fronts, commanded, respectively, by Nikolai Vatutin and Ivan Konev, encircled German forces of Army Group South in a pocket near the Dnieper River.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 科尔孙—切尔卡瑟战役又称科尔孙—切尔卡瑟包围战，是第二次世界大战期间的一场战役，发生于1944年1月24日至2月16日，属于苏联在乌克兰发起的第聂伯河—喀尔巴阡攻势，紧接在科尔孙—舍甫琴科夫斯基攻势之后。战役中，尼古拉·瓦图京和伊万·科涅夫分别指挥乌克兰第一方面军和第二方面军，将德军南方集团军群包围在第聂伯河附近。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle for the Recapture of Corregidor, 16–26 February 1945, pitted American forces against the defending Japanese garrison on the island fortress. The Japanese had captured the bastion from the United States Army Forces in the Far East during their 1942 invasion. The retaking of the island, officially named Fort Mills, along with the bloody battle to liberate Manila and the earlier recapture of the Bataan Peninsula, by invading U.S. forces from the occupying Japanese, marked the redemption of the American and Filipino surrender on 6 May 1942 and the subsequent fall of the Philippines.

zh.s: 1945年2月16日至26日，美军与据守科雷希多岛要塞的日军交战，夺回这座岛屿。日军曾在1942年入侵期间，从美国远东陆军手中夺取该要塞。美军从日军占领下收复正式名为米尔斯堡的科雷希多岛，加上解放马尼拉的血战及此前收复巴丹半岛，被视为洗雪1942年5月6日美菲军队投降及菲律宾随后沦陷的耻辱。

en.t: The Alaska Equal Rights Act of 1945, the first anti-discrimination law in the United States, was signed into law
en.s: In the history of discrimination in the United States, the Alaska Equal Rights Act of 1945 (also known as the Anti-Discrimination Law of 1945 Alaska Statutes 44.12.065) was the first state or territorial anti-discrimination law enacted in the United States in the 20th century. The law, signed on February 16, 1945, prevents and criminalizes discrimination against individuals in public areas based on race.

zh.t: 1945年《阿拉斯加平等权利法》签署生效
zh.s: 《1945年阿拉斯加平等权利法》也称《阿拉斯加反歧视法》（《阿拉斯加法典》第44.12.065条），是20世纪美国通过的首部州或领地反歧视法律。该法于1945年2月16日签署，禁止并将基于种族在公共场所歧视个人的行为定为犯罪。

en.s: The blockade of Wonsan, or the siege of Wonsan, from February 16, 1951, to July 27, 1953, during the Korean War, was the longest naval blockade in modern history, lasting 861 days. United Nations naval forces, primarily from the United States, kept the strategically important city of Wonsan from being used by the North Korean Navy. The blockade diverted communist troops from the front line.

zh.s: 朝鲜战争期间，从1951年2月16日至1953年7月27日，元山遭海上封锁，也称元山围困，持续861天，是现代史上最长的海上封锁。以美国为主的联合国海军阻止朝鲜海军使用这座战略重镇。封锁也迫使共产主义一方从前线分兵应对。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 16 February 1964. They resulted in a clear victory for Georgios Papandreou and his Center Union party. Papandreou had formed an interim government just after the legislative elections of 1963, in order to carry out new elections, because no party had the absolute majority in the Parliament. The Greek people voted for a strong and robust government, offering the Center Union a landslide victory. On the other hand, the National Radical Union was too weak, after Constantine Karamanlis had abandoned politics and exiled himself to Paris.

zh.s: 希腊于1964年2月16日举行议会选举，乔治斯·帕潘德里欧及其中央联盟明确获胜。1963年议会选举后，没有政党取得过半席位，帕潘德里欧组建临时政府，以再次举行选举。选民这次给予中央联盟压倒性胜利，希望建立稳固政府。与此同时，康斯坦丁·卡拉曼利斯退出政治、旅居巴黎后，民族激进联盟实力明显削弱。

en.s: The Vũng Rô Bay incident refers to the discovery of a 100-ton North Vietnamese naval trawler attempting to unload supplies and munitions on a beach in South Vietnam's Vũng Rô Bay on 16 February 1965. The incident spurred further United States Navy involvement in the Vietnam War.

zh.s: 翁罗湾事件指1965年2月16日发生的一起事件：一艘载有补给和弹药、重100吨的北越海军拖网渔船被发现试图在南越翁罗湾海滩卸货。此事促使美国海军进一步介入越南战争。

en.s: The Battles of Nakhang (16 February 1966–28 February 1969) were fought between Royalist forces and North Vietnamese invaders for control of the northern base of Nakhang, Laos. The Lima Site 36 airstrip at Nakhang was capable of handling aircraft up to the size of C-123 cargo carriers; its location and length made it a vital component of the Royalist defense.

en.s: Civil Air Transport Flight 10 was a scheduled passenger flight from the now-closed Kai Tak Airport in Hong Kong to Songshan Airport in Taipei, Taiwan. The flight, designated CT-010, was operated by a Boeing 727-92C registered as B-1018. On 16 February 1968, the aircraft crashed into Hunan village in Linkou Township, Taipei County (now Linkou District, New Taipei City), killing 21 people of the 64 people on board, as well as one person on the ground.

zh.t: 民航空运公司10号班机空难
zh.s: 民航空运公司10号班机、编号CT-010，是从香港启德机场飞往台湾台北松山机场的定期客运航班，由注册号B-1018的波音727-92C执行。1968年2月16日，飞机坠入台北县林口乡湖南村，即今天新北市林口区。机上64人中有21人死亡，另造成一名地面人员死亡。启德机场现已关闭。

en.s: The Ash Wednesday bushfires, known in South Australia as Ash Wednesday II, were a series of bushfires that occurred in south-eastern Australia in 1983 on 16 February. en.n: Iran launches Operation Dawn 5, a major offensive during the Iran–Iraq War targeting the Basra–Baghdad highway, resulting in heavy casualties on both sides.

en.s: On 16 February 1986, a Boeing 737-200 operating a charter flight as China Airlines Flight 2265 went missing after executing a go-around after touching down at Penghu Airport, Taiwan. It was discovered several weeks later on the seabed, 19 kilometres (12 mi; 10 nmi) north of the island. All 6 passengers and 7 crew members were confirmed dead.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Portugal on 26 January 1986, with a second round on 16 February. The first round was easily won by Freitas do Amaral, supported by all the right-wing parties, with 46% of the votes.

en.s: The Clonoe ambush happened on 16 February 1992 in the village of Clonoe, County Tyrone, Northern Ireland. en.s: Presidential elections were held in Cyprus on 16 February 2003. The election was dominated by the ongoing negotiations over the Annan Plan for Cyprus. en.t: The Kyoto Protocol comes into force, following its ratification by Russia
en.s: The Kyoto Protocol (Japanese: 京都議定書, Hepburn: Kyōto Giteisho) was an international treaty which extended the 1992 United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) that commits state parties to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, based on the scientific consensus that global warming is occurring and that human-made CO2 emissions are driving it. The Kyoto Protocol was adopted in Kyoto, Japan, on 11 December 1997 and entered into force on 16 February 2005.

en.s: Indirect presidential elections was to be held in Bangladesh on 16 February 2009 following the 2008 parliamentary election. en.t: Maziya wins the Maldivian Charity Shield
en.s: On 16 February 2017, Maziya defeated Club Valencia 1–0 in the Maldivian Charity Shield at the National Football Stadium in Malé, Maldives.

en.s: On February 16, 2017, the Lethwei in Japan2:Legacy event took place at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

en.s: The 2018 Angola Handball Super Cup (12th edition) was contested by Primeiro de Agosto, as the 2017 league champion and Interclube, the 2017 cup winner. Interclube won its 6th title. The 2018 Women's Super Cup (12th edition) was contested by Primeiro de Agosto, the 2017 women's league champion and Petro de Luanda, the 2016 cup winner. Petro Atlético was the winner, making it is's 10th title.

zh.s: 第12届安哥拉手球超级杯由2017年联赛冠军阿戈斯托一号队对阵2017年杯赛冠军国际俱乐部队，国际俱乐部队赢得了第六个冠军。第12届女子超级杯由2017年女子联赛冠军阿戈斯托一号队对阵2016年杯赛冠军罗安达石油队，罗安达石油队获胜，夺得队史第十冠。

en.s: The 2019 W-League grand final was the final match of the 2018–19 W-League season to decide the champions of women's soccer in Australia for the season. The match was played between Sydney FC and Perth Glory, at Netstrata Jubilee Stadium, with Sydney FC emerging victorious 4–2. This was referee Kate Jacewicz's ninth final out of the first eleven seasons of the W-League.

zh.t: 2019年澳大利亚女子职业足球联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2019年澳大利亚女子职业足球联赛总决赛是2018—19赛季的最后一场比赛，决出该赛季澳大利亚女足冠军。悉尼FC对阵珀斯光荣，比赛在内斯特拉塔禧年体育场举行，悉尼FC以4比2获胜。这是裁判凯特·杰斯维奇在联赛前11个赛季中执法的第9场总决赛。

en.s: NXT TakeOver: Portland was a 2020 professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's NXT brand division. It was the 28th NXT TakeOver event and took place on Sunday, February 16, 2020, at the Moda Center in Portland, Oregon. The event aired exclusively on the WWE Network and was the first TakeOver to be held on a Sunday.

zh.s: NXT接管：波特兰是WWE于2020年举办的职业摔角网络直播赛事，专供NXT品牌选手参赛。这是第28场NXT接管赛事，于2020年2月16日星期日在美国俄勒冈州波特兰摩达中心举行，由WWE Network独家播出。这也是首场在星期日举行的接管赛事。

en.s: The 2020 Supercopa do Brasil was the 3rd Supercopa do Brasil, an annual football match played between the champions of the 2019 Campeonato Brasileiro Série A and 2019 Copa do Brasil. The 2020 edition marked the return of the tournament, which since 1991 was not disputed. The match was played at the Estádio Nacional Mané Garrincha in Brasília on 16 February 2020.

zh.s: 2020年巴西超级杯是第三届赛事，由2019年巴西足球甲级联赛冠军与2019年巴西杯冠军交锋。本届标志着自1991年停办后的赛事回归，比赛于2020年2月16日在巴西利亚马内·加林查国家体育场举行。

en.s: The 2023 Tripura Legislative Assembly elections were held on 16 February 2023 to elect all 60 members of the Tripura Legislative Assembly. The votes were counted and the results were declared on 2 March 2023. The Bharatiya Janata Party won a simple majority, defeating its rivals Secular Democratic Forces and the Tipra Motha Party. Tipra Motha Party won 13 seats at its debut and became the largest opposition party in Tripura.

zh.s: 印度特里普拉邦于2023年2月16日举行议会选举，改选全部60席，并于3月2日计票、公布结果。印度人民党取得简单多数，击败世俗民主力量联盟及蒂普拉莫塔党。首次参选的蒂普拉莫塔党赢得13席，成为该邦最大反对党。

en.s: The 73rd annual Berlin International Film Festival, usually called the Berlinale (German pronunciation: [bɛʁliˈnaːlə] ), took place from 16 to 26 February 2023. It was the first completely in-person Berlinale since the 70th in 2020. The festival added a new competition section for television series. The festival opened with American filmmaker and novelist Rebecca Miller's drama film She Came to Me.

en.s: The 2023–24 Tunisian Super Cup was the 19th edition of the Tunisian Super Cup. The match was contested by the 2023–24 Tunisian Ligue Professionnelle 1 champions, Espérance de Tunis, and the 2023–24 Tunisian Cup winners, Stade Tunisien. The match took place at Hammadi Agrebi Stadium in Tunis on 16 February 2025.

zh.s: 2023—24赛季突尼斯超级杯是该项赛事的第19届，由2023—24赛季突尼斯职业足球甲级联赛冠军突尼斯希望队对阵2023—24赛季突尼斯杯冠军突尼斯体育场队。比赛于2025年2月16日在突尼斯的哈马迪·阿格雷比体育场举行。
